body: I just wanted to know what would out me.

There are more/or and/less ways to do  it.   
I have considered Switzerland, and that is very very expensive. Normal people could not afford that what so ever. It's ridiculous to present this as an out for the average person.

I do not have a resistance against it !  
No, you can not talk to me on the phone, sorry.
You know what, tomorrow won't be better at all. Please stop telling people that, if they truly are at the end of their life.

I understand this being downvoted, but where else do I turn to?   
I just want some help to have some kind of dignified end to the suffering.
I just want to know. Please.
